{{Quote|I hear that the tour transport is a technological marvel.|A tourist to [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Tour transports''' were large airworthy passenger vehicles used by the [[Coruscant City Tours]] organization to host their tours of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] famous landmarks. Such transports were reputed for using state-of-the-art technology.
